comparisons.label: explicit_dependencies
comparisons.scope: Same process/allocations. EU copy on compute node5 versus raw BLT MOCS2 on Copy node2;pre-recorded reusable batches. Setup,recording,guard validation excluded. Both timed arms use begin(queue,false) for independent copies;final visibility flush preserved. Host submit+completion wall time only;no CS timestamp commands in timed lists.

decision: Keep this as isolated Windows BCS staging. MOCS2 fixes the observed first-case BLT corruption; reusable raw Copy-node batches and cross-engine ordering pass. Standalone EU-versus-BCS timing does not prove a full-model or native-over-L0 win.
caveats: Frozen v14 allocator/KMT transport plus isolated Windows BCS changes; concurrent live local-ID/storage/resident/lookup/MTP work is excluded. No production runtime/adapter/binary/config,rootREADME or immutable Linux bundle changes.

No SPIR-V,zebin or EU kernel executes in the raw v4 BLT correctness matrix. Both target-memory policies,flush choices,and private-header choices are varied independently. All eight MOCS6 combinations fail at the FIRST 1-byte case;larger cases in those arms are not reached. All eight MOCS2 combinations complete73full-buffer checks each. This is calibrated driver/hardware evidence,not a portable cache-policy specification.

Process-local installed L0 capture uses six node2 submissions for the three dependent1-byte copies plus barriers;isolated native v3 uses one. L0 capture has11correct changed-data/guard checks;native v3 has11wrong destination bytes. Context-private data agree after excluding each process pointer/PID;submission header differences are captured but not identified as the data-failure cause.

Reusable BCS queues share existing immutable-list storage,resource lifetime tracking,KMT GPU dependencies,completion snapshots and host gates. Unsupported kernels,fill,and CS timestamp operations on copy-only queues reject. Pitched copies use row dispatch;image/tiled/compressed surfaces and production queue migration are not implemented.

Performance comparisons use native EU copy on compute node5 and raw MOCS2 BLT on Copy node2. Both are pre-recorded and reuse the same process,allocations,data and completion API. Timed intervals contain host submit plus completion wait,with no GPU timestamp instrumentation. Initialization,recording,validation,uploads/readback stay outside timing. Four sizes,1or32copies,H2D/D2D,two changed phases,oppositeABBA/BAAB,12warmups+48retainedsamples per case/phase.

Ordered queues retain per-copy visibility flushes. The second comparison uses begin(queue,false) in BOTH arms for independent buffers,leaving the final required visibility flush. This is an explicit-dependency API contract,not automatic alias analysis or permission to omit dependencies for overlapping copies.

Each matching null matrix actually reuses the SAME BCS list under both labels. Null variation and unlocked GPU clocks limit interpretation of small gains. Median paired rate changes differ from ratios of the separately summarized medians. No confidence interval or causal attribution of every small timing delta.

Cross-engine tests verify changed data,full guards,reusable unsignaled host gates,in-list memory tags,and BCS->EU->BCS dependencies without intermediate CPU waits. Correct ordering does not establish simultaneous execution or end-to-end overlap gains. Logical bytes are not measured physical PCIe traffic.
